title: unified-rollouts-add-probing-staged-shadow-canary-safety-guards
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Motivation: improve safety and observability for staged shadow/canary rollouts by adding a lightweight probing stage and explicit stability guards. This addresses incidents where slow metric convergence or noisy upstream traffic caused flaky autorollbacks or unsafe promotions. What this PR does: adds a new 'probing' stage that runs short, high-signal probes against the candidate model before it enters weighted canary. Probes are small synthetic requests and prioritized traffic slices that validate latency, correctness on targeted prompt sets, and key SLO metrics. It also introduces configurable stability guards and thresholds (multi-metric composite checks + rolling-window evaluation) used by the autorollback engine to reduce false positives and improve time-to-detection. Files changed are a mix of rollout controller logic, autorollback engine, e2e tests, and observability dashboards. Key runtime changes are feature-flag guarded and default to off for 1 week of canary. Checklist: - [x] Probing stage added to rollout state machine (probing -> shadow -> weighted-canary -> promote) - [x] Stability guards (composite metric evaluator, windowed thresholds) implemented in autorollback engine - [x] Observability: rollout timeline traces + probe-level metrics + grafana dashboard panels - [x] Unit tests for state transitions and comparator logic - [x] E2E smoke tests for staged rollout path including rollback scenarios - [x] Feature flag gate and rollout plan documented Testing and QA: unit tests (autorollback, state transitions), new integration tests simulate noisy traffic and check that probing prevents premature canary promotion. E2E tests run in CI (stable after two reruns). Manual verification performed on staging with a synthetic prompt set (ENG-1942). Rollout plan: behind feature flag rollout.probing_stage (default off). Enable for internal beta tenants for 48 hours -> enable for platform-internal namespaces for 72 hours -> opt-in for controlled customers -> enable by default after 1 week if no regressions. Autorollback conservatively requires 2 metric failures across different metric groups or a composite threshold breach to trigger automated rollback during probing. Related: Linear ENG-1942, ENG-2050. Links: design doc (internal), observability dashboard update PR. Notes: No breaking API changes. Changes to rollout behavior are opt-in and covered by feature flags. Release notes included below.
